set.body:
Source: P6 public-example requirement.

Scope:
- Add a non-published Scala 3.7 examples module whose main sources compile against the public APIs.
- Cover local and remote opaque scripts, declared outputs, bounded resumable logs, managed recovery, and typed Scala task results.
- Add focused tests and reader-facing documentation linking each workflow to its compile-checked source.
- Keep the examples deterministic and free of live Slurm or SSH side effects.

Acceptance:
- All six workflows compile from main sources on Scala 3.7.4.
- Tests exercise validation and orchestration helpers without a cluster.
- Formatting, full tests, and worker packaging pass.
- The new module is publish-skipped and introduces no production dependency cycle.
set.title: P6a: Add executable public API examples
